title: Bali in a Nutshell | Round Trip Flight Inclusive Deal From Delhi
highlights: Discover the magic of Bali, the Island of the Gods, where vibrant culture, lush landscapes, and iconic attractions create an unforgettable experience.
Snap stunning photos at Tegalalang Rice Terrace, where emerald paddies and palm-fringed hills create an iconic scene loved by travelers and Instagrammers alike.
Ride the longest river in Bali with an exhilarating whitewater rafting experience on the Ayung River, surrounded by jungle cliffs, waterfalls, and hidden carvings.
Climb Mount Batur, Bali’s most popular active volcano trek, and witness a stunning sunrise with sweeping views of Lake Batur, Mount Agung, and clouds drifting below your feet.
Snorkel through Nusa Penida’s world-renowned marine sites, where pristine reefs, tropical fish, and giant manta rays create one of Bali’s most memorable underwater adventures.
overview:
About the Tour:
Discover the best of Bali with this 7-day flight-inclusive package, featuring stays and travel across Ubud and Kuta. Your journey begins with the Kintamani & Ubud Tour, including a visit to a coffee plantation, Tegalalang Rice Terrace, and Ubud Palace. Get your adrenaline pumping with Ayung River white water rafting, followed by a scenic Uluwatu sunset tour at Padang Padang Beach. Witness the magical Mount Batur sunrise by jeep, explore Nusa Penida’s west coast gems, and unwind with the Campuhan Ridge Walk and Tegenungan Waterfall. This all-in-one package blends adventure, culture, and relaxation with hotel transfers and local meals included.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome! Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to the hotel. After you check in, relax for some time. Later, you can explore Ubud at your leisure. You can explore the sacred Ubud Monkey Forest, home to playful long-tailed macaques and ancient temples nestled in lush jungle. Alternatively, you can visit the luxurious Hanging Gardens of Bali, known for its iconic infinity pool overlooking the jungle. If you wish, you can also wander at Celuk Village, famous for its skilled silversmiths.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Discover the heart of Bali with a journey through Kintamani Highlands to enjoy stunning views of Mount Batur & its serene volcanic lake. Next, visit a coffee plantation to taste Bali’s unique blends, including the famous Luwak coffee. Stroll through the lush, scenic beauty of the Tegalalang Rice Terrace, a UNESCO-recognized cultural landscape. End your day at the vibrant Ubud Art Market, where you can purchase some souvenirs, & the historic Ubud Royal Palace, famed for its rich history.

items.title: Kintamani With Ubud Tour & Coffee Plantation Combo - Kintamani | Coffee Plantation | Tegalalang Rice Terrace | Ubud Market & Palace

days.title: Mt Batur Jeep Trek | Campuhan Ridge Walk Experience | Visit to Tegenungan Waterfall
days.desc: Leave before dawn to the Jeep Parking Area near Mt. Batur. Upon arriving, witness the sun rise over the volcanic landscape from a scenic viewpoint. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel & enjoy your breakfast. Later, get transferred to Campuhan Ridge & marvel at the surrounding lush greenery & serene valley views on a walking trail experience. Lastly, cool off with a visit to the stunning Tegenungan Waterfall, where you can relax by the natural pool or take a dip in the refreshing water.

items.title: Sunrise At Mount Batur by Jeep - Sunrise at Mount Batur by Jeep
Campuhan Ridge Walk Combo - Campuhan Ridge Walk & Tegenungan Waterfall

days.title: White Water Rafting at Ayung River | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: Check out & get driven to Kuta. En route, take a pause by the shores of Ayung River. Upon arriving, enjoy an exciting White Water Rafting experience on one of Bali’s most scenic and adventurous waterways. Paddle through moderate rapids as you navigate the river surrounded by towering cliffs, lush jungle, cascading waterfalls, and intricate stone carvings. After this thrilling adventure, continue towards Kuta. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.

items.title: White Water Rafting at Ayung River, Bali - Ayung River Rafting with Hotel Transfer + Lunch

days.title: Nusa Penida West Tour with Snorkeling Experience
days.desc: Start your day by getting driven to Sanur Harbor for a speedboat ride to Nusa Penida. Upon arrival, enjoy an amazing snorkeling session, where you’ll swim with vibrant reef fish and, if lucky, spot manta rays. Afterwards, explore Nusa Penida’s iconic west coast beginning with the dramatic cliffs of Kelingking Beach. Relax at the natural infinity pool of Angel’s Billabong, and witness the crashing waves at Broken Beach. Enjoy a local lunch with ocean views before returning back to the hotel.

days.title: Visit to Padang Padang Beach | Uluwatu Sunset Tour
days.desc: Begin your journey with a visit to Padang Padang Beach, a hidden gem nestled between limestone cliffs. Accessed by a narrow staircase, this small but beautiful beach is ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and watching surfers ride the waves. Next, visit Uluwatu Temple, perched dramatically on a cliff 70 meters above the Indian Ocean. As the sun begins to set, enjoy the breathtaking coastal views, the sound of waves crashing below, and the peaceful atmosphere surrounding this sacred site.

items.title: Day Trip to Uluwatu - Uluwatu Sunset Tour with Padang Padang Beach

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel & get driven to the airport for your flight back home. This is where your trip comes to an end.
